model_annotation: The diagram represents import and export values in billions of US dollars over time, comparing three different data series. The x-axis is labeled with years from 2020 to 2023, with a linear scale and tick labels at every year. The left y-axis is labeled "in Mrd. US-Dollar" and ranges from 0 to 400, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 50. The right y-axis also has a linear scale and ranges from -200 to 0. The diagram contains three data series: a blue line representing imports, a purple line representing exports, and blue bars representing the balance. The imports line starts at approximately 170 in 2020, peaks at around 280 in mid-2022, remains relatively stable until early 2023, and then rises to roughly 320 by the end of 2023. The exports line begins at around 100 in 2020, increases to about 160 by mid-2022, remains relatively stable until early 2023, and ends at roughly 170 in late 2023. The balance bars are consistently negative throughout the period, starting at around -80 in 2020 and becoming increasingly negative to approximately -150 by the end of 2023.
